title: Mexican Beef Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy mexican dish made with marinated beef on skewers, perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, mediterranean spice blend, lime juice, garlic powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
2. Add the beef to the marinade and mix well to coat.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
5. Thread the marinated beef, kidney, and any desired vegetables (such as onions, bell peppers, and mushrooms) onto skewers.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
7. Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, beans, and tortillas.
8. Garnish with fresh cilantro and lime wedges, if desired.
